besluite.rede: The elliptical 'en hoog teenoor laag ook' is natural Afrikaans; 'is ook een' is heavier and only reads differently.

besluite.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
besluite.rede: AWS writes language-name compounds with -sprekend as one word (cf. Afrikaanssprekende); meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
besluite.rede: Same AWS spelling fix, consistent with the other two occurrences.

besluite.fout: Verbless absolute tag copies an English 'both easy to carry' construction.
besluite.rede: A full clause with its own verb reads naturally for a Grade 6 reader and keeps the same referent and meaning.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'die kitaar staan' and 'baie groepe speel' are two full clauses joined by en, so the house comma rule applies.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'n Kitaarfrase kom terug' and 'dit is herhaling' each have subject and verb; the comma also separates the clause-joining en from 'oor en oor'.
'in plaas van om te sing' is accepted, natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral, more formal variant.

besluite.fout: 'Die vinnige praat' uses a bare verb as a noun awkwardly.
besluite.rede: 'Die vinnig gesproke deel' is natural, refers to the same fast-spoken section and matches the lesson's own izibongo entry.

besluite.fout: 'gesingde' is not the standard adjectival participle, and the AWS comma is missing.
besluite.rede: 'gesonge' is the correct form and the two full clauses take the comma; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'hoog en laag en maskandi' makes a reader stumble over where the second clause starts.
besluite.rede: The comma marks the start of the second (gapped) clause and fixes a first-reading stumble without changing what is said.

besluite.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
besluite.rede: Same AWS one-word spelling as items 2 and 3.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Albei het gegroei' and 'tog klink hulle' are two full clauses joined by en.

besluite.fout: 'n Suid-Afrikaanse soort koorsang' attaches the adjective to 'soort' rather than to 'koorsang'.
besluite.rede: A word-order rewording of a glossary definition goes beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must decide it.

besluite.fout: 'n Zoeloe-soort musiek' is an unnatural compound.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but rewording a glossary definition belongs to the writer, not a language agent.
